text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. After all, I am preparing for the
autumn
Tenno Sho.
choice_data_list: You're all fired up this year too!
You're all fired up this year too,...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've conquered the spring
Tenno Sho, my desire to win both spring
and autumn in
succession has grown all
the stronger!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall hone my skills even more this
summer camp
so I may achieve a
spectacular victory for the
Mejiro family!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'll do whatever it takes. I
don't care
how strict your training is!
choice_data_list: 'll help you with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Create a regimen that will ensure my
victory in
the upcoming autumn Tenno
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen and I begin our final
summer
camp together!
